the turtle had just become a buddhist.
choices.zh: 这只乌龟刚刚成为了一名佛教徒。

answer_evidence.quote: A large shell rose from the water.
"It's a giant turtle!" said Bajie.
The turtle bowed its head toward Wukong.
"That demon had taken over my house and river. Thank you for getting rid of him."
"I have been a good Buddhist for over a thousand years," said the turtle.
"But sadly I'm still just a turtle. Can you ask Buddha when I will be reborn as a human?"

prompt.en: what did the turtle offer to do?

choices.en: take the travelers across the river
build a boat for the travelers
give his house to the demon

answer_evidence.quote: The turtle then looked at the villagers.
"You don't need to make a boat. I can take the travelers across the river."
"You're traveling to the Western Paradise to get scriptures from Buddha. I knew you would cross my river eventually. Climb onto my shell."
After a little more hesitation, the travelers stepped onto the turtle's shell.
The turtle began to paddle.

prompt.en: what did the turtle want to know?

choices.en: when he would be reborn as a human
why there were so many demons
choices.zh: 为什么会有这么多恶魔

answer_evidence.quote: The turtle glanced back at the Tang Monk.
"Excuse me, but can you do me a favor?"
"Of course," said the monk.
"What do you need me to do?"
"I have been a good Buddhist for over a thousand years," said the turtle.
"But sadly I'm still just a turtle. Can you ask Buddha when I will be reborn as a human?"
The Tang Monk nodded.
"I will ask him."

prompt.en: what did wukong tell the tang monk not to do?
prompt.zh: 悟空告诉唐僧不要做什么？

answer_evidence.quote: "Look!" said the Tang Monk, pointing.
Higher up the mountain was a large monastery.
Wukong looked at the monastery.
A dark mist hung over it.
The monkey shook his head.
"That's a bad place. We're not going there."
"And I see a dark mist hanging over that monastery. A demon could be in there."
"No," said Wukong sharply. "Stay here. I will find food for us."
He looked at the monk and warned him again, "Do not go to that monastery!"
